latestScoreAudit.scope: Read-only score audit of current remote main; not used for fixed recommendation comparison.

contract.rawScore: number, finite, 0<=score<=100; zero valid; no minimum score policy introduced
contract.eligibility: Own scoreEligible property, value exactly true. Missing/null/string/1 are unknown and rejected for recommendations.
contract.requiredData: Array missingScoreFields explicitly empty; weekly finite/nonnegative windSpeed, windDirectionDeg<360 and precipitation3h; wave finite/nonnegative when showWave/island/pelagic. Today adapter validates generator formatted wind/rain and wave where required.
contract.rankScore: Finite raw score plus existing maximum 16 report bonus; rank may exceed 100 and is not clamped by raw-score range.
contract.independentGates: Numerical validity is separate from season/daylight/forecast provenance/freshness, absolute 90-minute tide proximity, precipitation and ship safety. No existing P0 gate is relaxed.
contract.display: Invalid numeric score produces unconfirmed score/grade; raw weather/tide facts remain readable. Analysis wrapper exercises numeric display guard, not a browser implementation.

evidenceLimit: Synthetic current defects reproduce malformed/contradictory score inputs; no invalid eligible score exists in fixed 10,640 sample set or audited latest main. Does not establish operational leak or ecological probability. Wrapper tests expected design behavior only, not implemented production changes.
